_comment: Rhai completion + hover catalog. THE SHIPPED ENGINE IS CANONICAL: crates/aitm-plugin-rhai/tests/api_catalog.rs asserts a bijection between the engine's registered host surface (gen_fn_signatures) and the IMPLEMENTED entries here, so every implemented entry must name a real registered token and every registered author-facing token must appear here. Entries with "status": "planned" (the dsl crypto/encoding helpers) are specced but not yet registered on the engine; they are excluded from the bijection until a production follow-up lands them. Entry names are fully qualified (`flow.request.headers.get`); a surface completes the last segment after the receiver chain. `kind` is object | property | method | function. In-script Rhai method names can differ from the MCP/CLI tool names (browser.type_text vs the browser.type tool, browser.evaluate vs browser.eval) because `type`/`eval` are Rhai reserved words.

hooks.name: load
hooks.description: Called once at startup with the registration handle; register script commands and options here.

hooks.name: on_request_headers
hooks.description: Fires on the RequestHeaders event, before the request body is read.

hooks.name: on_request
hooks.description: Fires on the Request event, once the full request is available; mutate it before it goes upstream.

hooks.name: on_response_headers
hooks.description: Fires on the ResponseHeaders event, before the response body is read.

hooks.name: on_response
hooks.description: Fires on the Response event, once the full response is available.

hooks.name: on_ws_start
hooks.description: Fires on the WsStart event, when a WebSocket connection is established.

hooks.name: on_ws_message
hooks.description: Fires on the WsMessage event for each WebSocket frame; msg is the message object.

hooks.name: on_ws_end
hooks.description: Fires on the WsEnd event, when a WebSocket connection closes.

hooks.name: on_error
hooks.description: Fires on the Error event with the flow and the error.

flow.name: flow.id
flow.description: The flow's id.

flow.name: flow.kind
flow.description: Whether this is an HTTP or a WebSocket flow.

flow.name: flow.marks
flow.description: The marks on this flow (settable).

flow.name: flow.comment
flow.description: The operator comment on this flow (settable).

flow.name: flow.is_replay

flow.name: flow.request
flow.description: The request side of the flow.

flow.name: flow.request.method

flow.name: flow.request.url

flow.name: flow.request.path
flow.description: The request path (settable).

flow.name: flow.request.headers
flow.description: The request headers, a map-like object.

flow.name: flow.request.headers.get

flow.name: flow.request.headers.set
flow.description: Set header k to v.

flow.name: flow.request.headers.remove

flow.name: flow.request.headers.has

flow.name: flow.request.headers.keys

flow.name: flow.request.query
flow.description: The query parameters, a map-like object.

flow.name: flow.response
flow.description: The response side of the flow.

flow.name: flow.response.status
flow.description: The response status code (settable).

flow.name: flow.response.headers
flow.description: The response headers, a map-like object.

flow.name: flow.response.headers.get
flow.description: The value of header k.

flow.name: flow.response.headers.set
flow.description: Set header k to v.

flow.name: flow.response.headers.remove
flow.description: Remove header k.

flow.name: flow.response.headers.has
flow.description: True when header k is present.

flow.name: flow.response.headers.keys
flow.description: The header names, as an array.

flow.name: flow.response.body
flow.description: The response body.

flow.name: flow.response.bytes
flow.description: The response body as raw bytes (get/set).

flow.name: flow.set_response

flow.name: flow.intercept
flow.description: Pause this flow for operator intervention.

flow.name: flow.resume
flow.description: Resume a paused flow.

flow.name: flow.kill
flow.description: Kill this flow.

flow.name: flow.backup
flow.description: Snapshot the flow so it can be reverted.

flow.name: flow.revert
flow.description: Restore the flow to its last backup.

flow.name: flow.mark
flow.description: Add a mark to this flow.

msg.name: msg.set_text
msg.description: Replace the frame payload with the text s.

msg.name: msg.set_bytes
msg.description: Replace the frame payload with the bytes b.

globals.name: log
globals.description: Write msg to the script's log.

globals.name: log.info
globals.description: Log at info level.

globals.name: log.warn
globals.description: Log at warn level.

globals.name: log.error
globals.description: Log at error level.

globals.name: http.send
globals.signature: http.send(#{ method, url, headers, body }) -> #{ status, headers, body, flow_id }
globals.description: Send an HTTP request through the proxy's own client (scope- and rate-gated); the exchange is captured as a flow.

globals.name: browser.navigate
globals.description: Navigate the embedded browser to url (scope- and SSRF-gated).

globals.name: browser.click
globals.description: Click an element by selector, or a point by coordinates.

globals.name: browser.type_text
globals.description: Type text into the element matching selector. In-script Rhai method name is `type_text` (`type` is a Rhai reserved word); the MCP/CLI tool is still named `browser.type`.

globals.name: browser.screenshot
globals.description: Capture the page as PNG bytes.

globals.name: browser.evaluate
globals.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression in the page. In-script Rhai method name is `evaluate` (`eval` is a Rhai reserved word); the MCP/CLI tool is still named `browser.eval`.

globals.name: browser.get_dom
globals.description: The page's DOM as a string.

globals.name: store.get
globals.description: Read one flow from the flow store by id.

globals.name: store.query
globals.signature: store.query(#{ host, method, status, kind, is_replay }) -> array of flow views
globals.description: Query the flow store; returns matching flow views.

globals.name: scope.add
globals.description: Add host to the authorised scope.

globals.name: scope.list
globals.description: The hosts currently in scope.

globals.name: option
globals.description: The value of an option set at load.

globals.name: halt
globals.description: Return from a hook to halt the plugin chain (Verdict::Halt). Returning nothing continues the chain.

globals.name: finding
globals.signature: finding(#{ name, severity, flow_id, detail, tags })

globals.name: ok
globals.description: Prelude helper: wrap resp as a successful short-circuit response.

globals.name: contains_ci
globals.description: Prelude helper: case-insensitive substring check.

globals.name: json
globals.description: Prelude helper: encode the map m as a JSON string.

dsl.name: b64_encode
dsl.description: Base64-encode s. PLANNED: specced but not yet registered on the engine; a production follow-up implements it, at which point it leaves the planned bucket and the drift guard requires the engine token.

dsl.name: b64_decode
dsl.description: Base64-decode s. PLANNED: not yet registered on the engine.

dsl.name: url_encode
dsl.description: Percent-encode s for use in a URL. PLANNED: not yet registered on the engine.

dsl.name: hex_encode
dsl.description: Hex-encode s. PLANNED: not yet registered on the engine.

dsl.name: sha256
dsl.description: SHA-256 digest of s. PLANNED: not yet registered on the engine.

dsl.name: md5
dsl.description: MD5 digest of s. PLANNED: not yet registered on the engine.

dsl.name: rand_text_alpha
dsl.description: A random string of n letters. PLANNED: not yet registered on the engine.

dsl.name: rand_int
dsl.description: A random integer between a and b. PLANNED: not yet registered on the engine.

dsl.name: regex_match
dsl.description: True when pattern pat matches s. PLANNED: not yet registered on the engine.

dsl.name: regex_extract
dsl.description: The capture group of pat's match in s. PLANNED: not yet registered on the engine.

reg.name: reg.add_command
reg.description: Register a script command, callable from `load(reg)`. `reg` is the registration handle passed to the load hook.

reg.name: reg.add_option
reg.description: Register a configurable option, callable from `load(reg)`; read it back later with `option(name)`.

vars.name: vars.get
vars.description: Read a PoC run variable by name. `vars` is the per-step handle a PoC `script:` step runs against.

vars.name: vars.set
vars.description: Set a PoC run variable, visible to later steps.

denied.name: denied.capability
denied.description: The capability that was denied. `denied` is the token a scope-/SSRF-gated host call returns when it is refused.

denied.name: denied.host
denied.description: The host the denied call targeted.
